story.text: Sir Walter Elliot of Kellynch Hall never takes up any book but the {BARONETAGE}, where he reads of himself. Vain of his looks and his rank, he has lived far beyond his {INCOME}. His agent, Mr. Shepherd, drops {UNWELCOME} hints: they must {RETRENCH}, or let Kellynch. And Anne, the {KINDEST} of his daughters, is nobody to him.
story.caption: The unwelcome hints of Mr. Shepherd, his agent
